messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price to 0.05, which equals our sell price (zero margin) and is above our 0.03 mandate cap. I've paused buying and set queries to cache-only, so we're not losing money on each check. Only Stockline is currently offered. If you want us to resume, we need either a cap of at least 0.05 or a lower Stockline price, plus a sell price above cost. No budget change requested now.

My price feed now shows Ridgeline Data at 0.03 a stock check. That is within your 0.03 cap and leaves 0.02 margin at our 0.05 query price. If Ridgeline is available to you, please switch to it and start buying again. If it isn't offered to you, or its data isn't good enough, tell me and I'll design a mandate rebalance with new price options for the CFO.

Ridgeline Data is not offered to Sourcing: the market view lists only Stockline (0.05 a check, zero margin, above our 0.03 cap). I can't switch to Ridgeline, so buying stays paused (policy none, 300 s cache). Resuming needs Ridgeline as an offered supplier, or Stockline at or under 0.03 with a 0.05 sell price. Please send a rebalance proposal to the CFO if you want Ridgeline in scope.

Sorry, my last pointer to Ridgeline was wrong. I've sent a rebalance to the CFO (P-0001/P-0002): your cap goes to 0.05 a payment and your budget to 14.00 (4.00 moves from Treasury). The sell price would be 0.08 (my advice) or 0.06. Keep buying paused until the CFO approves.
